document_zh: 输出质量校样与可及性走查记录（方案方自查）
document_en: Output Proofing and Accessibility Walkthrough Record (Proposer's Self-Check)

nature.predominant_method_zh: 机器辅助校验为主，人工判读为辅
nature.predominant_method_en: Predominantly machine-assisted verification, with human reading as a secondary check
nature.metrics_effect_zh: 无。本文件不产生任何指标数值；metrics.json 中七项包容性指标保持待实测。
nature.metrics_effect_en: None. This file produces no metric value; the seven inclusion metrics in metrics.json remain unmeasured.
nature.statement_zh: 本文件登记的是本方案自己做过的三类检查：按实际输出尺寸的字号与对比度校样、双语等价抽检、HTML 无障碍走查。三类检查均由方案方自行执行，以脚本量测与结构比对为主要手段，未经任何第三方机构认证，未经辅助技术使用者实测，也未经具备资质的译者逐词审校。凡本次未亲自复测而引自包内既有登记的读数，均在条目的 provenance 字段注明出处。
nature.statement_en: This file records three checks the proposer actually performed: type-size and contrast proofing at the real output size, bilingual-equivalence sampling, and an HTML accessibility walkthrough. All three were run by the proposer, primarily through scripted measurement and structural comparison. None was certified by a third party, tested with assistive-technology users, or reviewed word by word by a qualified translator. Any reading quoted from an existing package register rather than re-measured in this round is attributed in the entry's provenance field.

records.title_zh: 记录一 · 按实际输出尺寸的字号与对比度校样
records.title_en: Record 1 · Type-size and contrast proofing at real output size
records.purpose_zh: 在评审真实接收成果的尺寸与分辨率上量测字号与对比度，而不是在制作端的放大视图上判断可读性。
records.purpose_en: To measure type size and contrast at the size and resolution at which reviewers actually receive the material, rather than judging legibility on a zoomed authoring view.

checks.item_zh: A3 双语图册页面文本层最小字号
checks.item_en: Minimum type size in the page text layer of the A3 bilingual booklet
checks.method_zh: 对生成 A3 页面的 DOM 逐元素读取 computedStyle 的 font-size，按 px × 0.75 = pt 换算为印刷字号，取全册最小值
checks.method_en: Read computedStyle font-size element by element on the DOM that generates the A3 pages, convert with px x 0.75 = pt, and take the minimum across the booklet
checks.tool: DOM computedStyle 实测（px×0.75=pt 口径）
checks.scope_zh: A3 双语册全 24 页（中文 12 页 + 英文 12 页），页面文本层
checks.scope_en: All 24 pages of the A3 bilingual booklet (12 zh + 12 en), page text layer
checks.result_zh: 页面文本层最小 9.07 pt；一级判断卡最小 9.35 pt；图例最小 9.07 pt
checks.result_en: Page text layer minimum 9.07 pt; primary judgement cards minimum 9.35 pt; legends minimum 9.07 pt
checks.provenance: 包内 changelog.md 2026-08-13「A3 拆页」条目登记；本轮未重跑该量测
checks.limitations_zh: 屏幕渲染量测，未做实物打印比对；不同打印设备的墨迹扩散与纸张会改变实际可读性

checks.item_zh: A3 图册页数与文件体量核对
checks.item_en: Page count and file size verification of the A3 booklet
checks.method_zh: 直接解析 PDF 页树的 /Count 与 /Type /Page 标记计数，并读取文件字节数
checks.method_en: Parse the PDF page tree /Count and /Type /Page markers directly, and read file byte size
checks.tool: Node.js 直读 PDF 字节流
checks.scope_en: drawings/a3-booklet.pdf and drawings/a3-booklet.en.pdf
checks.result_en: 12 pages / 2,078,274 bytes (zh) and 12 pages / 1,710,501 bytes (en); 24 pages in total, matching the registered 12 x 2
checks.limitations_zh: 仅核对页数与体量，不核对页面内容

checks.item_zh: A3 图版裁切带内注记的等效印刷字号
checks.item_en: Effective print type size of annotations inside cropped drawing bands on A3
checks.method_zh: 按图版嵌入 A3 页面后的实际缩放比例，把图版原始像素字高折算为 A3 印刷尺寸下的等效 pt 值
checks.method_en: Convert the source pixel cap height of the drawing into an equivalent pt value at A3 print size, using the actual scale at which the drawing is embedded
checks.tool: 版面缩放比折算（图版原始字高 × 嵌入缩放比 × 0.75）
checks.scope_zh: A3 双语册内嵌图版的裁切带注记
checks.scope_en: Annotations inside the cropped drawing bands embedded in the A3 bilingual booklet
checks.result_en: Effective print size 4.48-12.05 pt, up from 2.98-3.70 pt before the re-pagination (a 1.50-3.38x increase)
checks.provenance: 包内 changelog.md 2026-08-13 条目登记；本轮未重跑该量测
checks.reading_discipline_zh: 全部判断语、图例与限定语位于页面文本层（下限 9.07 pt），图带只承担形态证据；读者不需要读图带内注记也能获得完整判断。
checks.reading_discipline_en: All judgements, legends, and qualifying statements sit in the page text layer (floor 9.07 pt); the drawing band carries morphological evidence only, so a reader obtains the full judgement without reading the in-band annotations.
checks.limitations_zh: 下限 4.48 pt 低于印刷常规下限（一般不低于 6 pt）。这是已知取舍而非疏漏：该量级的注记只出现在图带内，其判断内容已上移至页面文本层。

checks.item_zh: A0 双语展板版面文本字号下限
checks.item_en: Type-size floor of the A0 bilingual boards
checks.method_zh: 对生成 A0 板面的 DOM 逐元素读取 computedStyle 的 font-size，按 px × 0.75 = pt 换算，形成读数台账并取下限
checks.method_en: Read computedStyle font-size element by element on the DOM that generates the A0 boards, convert with px x 0.75 = pt, compile a reading register, and take the floor
checks.tool: DOM computedStyle 实测（px×0.75=pt 口径），台账 128 项读数
checks.scope_zh: A0 双语展板全 12 板（中文 6 板 + 英文 6 板）
checks.scope_en: All 12 A0 bilingual boards (6 zh + 6 en)
checks.result_zh: 版面文本字号下限 8.51 pt，页脚 11.34 pt
checks.result_en: Layout text floor 8.51 pt, footer 11.34 pt
checks.provenance: 2026-08-12 量测台账（128 项读数）；本轮以 PDF 页树复核板数为 6 × 2 = 12，未重跑字号量测
checks.limitations_zh: 屏幕渲染量测；A0 展板的实际可读性还取决于张贴高度与观看距离，本次未做现场观看距离验证

checks.item_zh: 五张评审可见图在接收分辨率下的可读性
checks.item_en: Legibility of the five reviewer-visible drawings at receiving resolution
checks.method_zh: 把图版按评审通道的接收分辨率（短边压至 768 像素）重采样，逐个文本要素计算重采样后的实际字号与可读判定，统计不可读文本占比；key-areas 一图另做栅格墨迹高度实测
checks.method_en: Resample each drawing to the reviewing channel's receiving resolution (short edge reduced to 768 px), compute the resulting size and legibility verdict for every text element, and tally the share of illegible text; key-areas additionally measured by raster ink height
checks.tool: readability.js（DOM 实测）+ key-areas 栅格墨迹高度实测
checks.scope_zh: site-overview、land-use-structure、key-areas、mobility-bluegreen、metrics-evidence 五图的中英双版共十张
checks.scope_en: Ten files in total: the zh and en versions of site-overview, land-use-structure, key-areas, mobility-bluegreen, and metrics-evidence
checks.result_zh: 十张图不可读文本占比全部为 0%，最小字号 12.1—12.3 px（接收分辨率口径），经三轮重排后达成
checks.result_en: Illegible-text share is 0% on all ten files, with a minimum of 12.1-12.3 px at receiving resolution, reached after three rounds of re-layout
checks.provenance: 2026-08-13 三轮重排完成时的量测；本轮以文件清单复核十张图双语成对齐备，未重跑可读性量测
checks.limitations_zh: 以重采样后的字号阈值判定可读，不等于真实读者在具体显示设备与观看距离下的可读；未做读者阅读测试

checks.item_zh: 对比度抽检（WCAG 2.1 相对亮度公式）
checks.item_en: Contrast sampling (WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula)
checks.method_zh: 按 WCAG 2.1 相对亮度与对比度公式计算前景色与背景色之比，按正文与大字两档判定门槛（AA-normal 4.5:1，AA-large 3:1）
checks.method_en: Compute foreground-to-background ratios with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance and contrast formulas, judged against the normal-text and large-text thresholds (AA-normal 4.5:1, AA-large 3:1)
checks.tool: WCAG 2.1 对比度公式计算；本轮以包内展示页色板独立复算
checks.scope_zh: 图版与展示页共用的品牌色板配色对
checks.scope_en: Colour pairs from the brand palette shared by the drawings and the display page
checks.result_zh: 正文 12.69、次级字 7.26、警示行 7.13、节号 5.01、图例 4.60，均达 AA-normal；限定短标 3.26、图面免责 3.14，以 700 字重按 AA-large 判定
checks.result_en: Body 12.69, secondary 7.26, alert row 7.13, section number 5.01, legend 4.60, all meeting AA-normal; short qualifiers 3.26 and on-drawing disclaimers 3.14, judged as AA-large at weight 700
checks.recomputation_zh: 本轮用包内展示页色板独立复算，七项中五项精确复现并可定位到具体配色对：12.69 = #10383d 于 #ffffff；7.26 = #10383d 于 #a8cbc5；5.01 = #177c78 于 #ffffff；4.60 = #68787b 于 #ffffff；3.14 = #d76450 于 #f2efe7。另两项（警示行 7.13、限定短标 3.26）取自图版专用色，其配色对不在展示页色板登记范围内，本轮无法用展示页色板复现。
checks.recomputation_en: Independently recomputed this round from the display-page palette: five of the seven reproduce exactly and can be traced to a specific pair (12.69 = #10383d on #ffffff; 7.26 = #10383d on #a8cbc5; 5.01 = #177c78 on #ffffff; 4.60 = #68787b on #ffffff; 3.14 = #d76450 on #f2efe7). The other two (alert row 7.13, short qualifiers 3.26) come from drawing-specific colours that are not registered in the display-page palette and could not be reproduced from it this round.
checks.limitations_zh: 对比度按 sRGB 数值计算，反映的是数字稿；印刷油墨、纸张与照明会改变实际对比度，本次未做印品实测。AA-large 判定依赖字重与字号同时成立，若该处文字在某一输出尺寸下缩小到大字门槛以下，则该项判定不再适用。

record_limitations_zh: 全部读数为屏幕渲染量测，与实物印刷存在渲染差异；本包未做实物打印样张检查。
A3 图带内注记的下限 4.48 pt 低于印刷常规下限，属已知取舍：该量级注记只承担形态证据，其判断内容已上移至页面文本层（下限 9.07 pt）。
字号与对比度达标不等于可读性达标；真实可读性还取决于字体、语言、观看距离、照明与读者视力，本次均未测。
record_limitations_en: All readings are screen-rendered measurements and differ from physical print; no physical press proof was made for this package.

The 4.48 pt floor of in-band annotations on A3 is below the usual print floor. This is a known trade-off: annotations at that size carry morphological evidence only, and their judgement content has been moved up into the page text layer (floor 9.07 pt).

Meeting size and contrast thresholds is not the same as being legible; real legibility also depends on typeface, language, viewing distance, lighting, and the reader's vision, none of which was tested.

records.title_zh: 记录二 · 双语等价抽检
records.purpose_zh: 核对中英两版在结构、计数与证据锚点上是否等价，使评审无论读哪一版都得到同一套判断与同一组证据入口。
records.purpose_en: To verify that the Chinese and English versions are equivalent in structure, counts, and evidence anchors, so that a reviewer receives the same judgements and the same evidence entry points from either version.

checks.item_zh: proposal 正文逐行结构类型比对
checks.item_en: Line-by-line structural-type comparison of the proposal text
checks.method_zh: 把双语正文逐行归入结构类型（标题及其层级、表格行及其列数、表格分隔行、列表、引用、代码围栏、分隔线、正文段），折叠空行后逐行比对类型序列
checks.method_en: Classify every line of both versions into a structural type (heading with level, table row with column count, table separator, list, quote, code fence, rule, body paragraph), then compare the type sequences line by line with blank lines collapsed
checks.tool: Node.js 结构分类比对脚本
checks.scope_en: The full text of proposal.md and proposal.en.md
checks.result_zh: 非空行 478 行对 478 行，结构类型逐行不一致数为 0
checks.result_en: 478 non-blank lines on each side, with zero line-by-line type mismatches
checks.limitations_zh: 结构级比对，不判断译文是否准确、是否遗漏语义

checks.item_zh: 标题数量与层级序列比对
checks.item_en: Heading count and level-sequence comparison
checks.method_zh: 抽取全部 ATX 标题，比对数量与层级序列
checks.method_en: Extract all ATX headings and compare count and level sequence
checks.tool: Node.js 结构分类比对脚本
checks.scope_en: The full text of proposal.md and proposal.en.md
checks.result_en: 27 headings on each side, with the level sequence 1,2,2,2,2,3,3,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,3,3,2,2,2,2,3,3,3,3,2,2,2 identical in both
checks.limitations_zh: 只比对结构，不比对标题措辞的对应关系

checks.item_zh: 表格行数与逐行列数比对
checks.item_en: Table row count and per-row column count comparison
checks.method_zh: 抽取全部表格行，比对总行数、数据行数，并逐行比对列数
checks.method_en: Extract every table line, compare total lines and data rows, and compare column counts row by row
checks.tool: Node.js 结构分类比对脚本
checks.scope_en: The full text of proposal.md and proposal.en.md
checks.result_zh: 表格行 221 对 221（含分隔行），数据行 189 对 189，逐行列数全等，列数不一致索引为空集
checks.result_en: 221 table lines on each side (separators included), 189 data rows on each side, per-row column counts identical, with an empty mismatch index set
checks.limitations_zh: 比对的是表格骨架，不比对单元格内容的译文对应

checks.item_zh: 证据锚点分类计数比对
checks.item_en: Evidence-anchor count comparison by kind
checks.method_zh: 按锚点类型分别计数并比对；检索的候选类型为 metric、data、source、assumption、figure、geometry、file、standard、compliance 九类，登记实际出现的类型
checks.method_en: Count and compare anchors by kind; nine candidate kinds were searched (metric, data, source, assumption, figure, geometry, file, standard, compliance) and the kinds actually present are registered
checks.tool: Node.js 正则计数
checks.scope_en: The full text of proposal.md and proposal.en.md
checks.result_zh: 实际出现四类：metric 64 对 64、data 40 对 40、source 68 对 68、standard 12 对 12，合计 184 对 184，四类全部持平
checks.result_en: Four kinds are present: metric 64/64, data 40/40, source 68/68, standard 12/12, totalling 184/184, all balanced
checks.provenance: 本轮实测（本记录文件的挂接句在双方各新增一个 data 锚点，改动后仍为双侧持平）
checks.limitations_zh: 计数持平只说明锚点未在翻译中丢失，不说明每个锚点指向的证据本身成立

checks.item_zh: A3 双语册逐页结构块计数比对与溢出检测
checks.item_en: Page-by-page structural-block comparison and overflow detection on the A3 bilingual booklet
checks.method_zh: 对生成 A3 页面的 DOM 逐页统计 28 类结构块的数量并双语比对，同时检测每一页内容框的溢出量
checks.method_en: Count 28 kinds of structural block per page on the DOM that generates the A3 pages, compare between languages, and detect content-box overflow on every page
checks.tool: pagecheck.js
checks.scope_en: All 24 pages of the A3 bilingual booklet
checks.result_zh: 28 类结构块逐页计数比对 PASS，溢出检测 0
checks.result_en: Page-by-page comparison of 28 structural-block kinds PASS, overflow detection 0
checks.provenance: 包内既有检查记录；本轮未重跑
checks.detected_and_fixed_zh: 该检查曾在历轮查获英文版一处 19.6 毫米内容溢出并已修复。此项如实登记，用以说明该比对确实具备查错能力，而非只产出通过结论。
checks.detected_and_fixed_en: In an earlier round this check caught a 19.6 mm content overflow in the English booklet, which was then fixed. It is recorded here to show the comparison actually detects faults rather than only producing pass results.
checks.limitations_zh: 结构块级比对，不比对页面内文字的译文准确性

checks.item_zh: 评审可见图版双语成对与核心指标读数一致性
checks.item_en: Bilingual pairing of reviewer-visible drawings and consistency of headline metric readings
checks.method_zh: 按文件名规则枚举图版目录，核对每张中文图存在对应英文图；并核对图上人读位的核心指标与 metrics.json 的 display 位是否一致
checks.method_en: Enumerate the figures directory by filename rule and verify that each Chinese drawing has an English counterpart; also verify that headline metrics printed for human reading match the display fields in metrics.json
checks.tool: 文件清单枚举 + 数值比对
checks.scope_zh: assets/figures 全部 16 个图版文件；五张评审可见图的中英双版
checks.scope_en: All 16 files in assets/figures; the zh and en versions of the five reviewer-visible drawings
checks.result_zh: 16 个图版文件全部成对，五张评审可见图的中英双版齐备；核心指标人读位与 metrics.json 的 display 位一致
checks.result_en: All 16 drawing files are paired and the five reviewer-visible drawings are present in both languages; the headline metrics read by humans match the display fields in metrics.json
checks.provenance: 成对性为本轮实测；读数一致性引自包内既有检查记录
checks.limitations_zh: 成对性是文件级核对，不核对两版图面内容是否逐项对应

checks.item_zh: 双语字幕轨时间轴同源核对
checks.item_en: Same-source verification of bilingual caption timelines
checks.method_zh: 解析 WebVTT 文件，比对 cue 条数与全部时间戳序列是否逐条相同
checks.method_en: Parse the WebVTT files and compare cue counts and the full sequence of timestamps entry by entry
checks.tool: Node.js WebVTT 解析比对
checks.scope_en: Four caption files under assets/media: journey.vtt, journey-en.vtt, audio-guide.vtt, audio-guide-en.vtt
checks.result_zh: 四个文件均为合规 WebVTT；短片字幕 11 条对 11 条，时间轴逐条完全相同；语音导览字幕 26 条对 26 条，时间轴逐条完全相同
checks.result_en: All four are valid WebVTT; the film captions are 11 cues on each side with identical timelines entry by entry, and the audio-guide captions are 26 cues on each side with identical timelines entry by entry
checks.provenance: 本轮实测；短片字幕在 2026-08-13 重录时曾逐条人工核对
checks.limitations_zh: 时间轴同源只说明两版切分一致，不说明译文与语音内容逐句对应

checks.item_zh: 文字稿存在性核对
checks.item_en: Presence check for full transcripts
checks.method_zh: 枚举媒体目录，核对每件时基媒体是否配有随包文字稿
checks.method_en: Enumerate the media directory and verify that each time-based medium is accompanied by a transcript in the package
checks.tool: 文件清单枚举
checks.scope_en: The assets/media directory
checks.result_zh: journey.mp4 配 journey.md（分镜表与旁白全文），audio-guide.m4a 配 audio-guide.md，封面配 cover.md；三份文字稿均存在
checks.result_en: journey.mp4 is accompanied by journey.md (shot list and full narration), audio-guide.m4a by audio-guide.md, and the cover by cover.md; all three transcripts exist
checks.limitations_zh: 只核对文字稿存在，未逐句核对文字稿与音轨内容的一致性

record_limitations_zh: 本记录是结构级与抽样级核对，不是逐词翻译审校。
英文版由模型生成后经人工规则校验（结构、计数、锚点、术语一致性），未经具备资质的译者逐词审校，也未经英语母语专业读者通读。
结构等价不保证语义等价：两版可以结构完全对齐而个别措辞的含义强度不同，这一层本次未测。
record_limitations_en: This record covers structural and sampled checks, not a word-by-word translation review.

The English version was model-generated and then checked against rules by hand (structure, counts, anchors, terminology consistency). It was not reviewed word by word by a qualified translator, nor read through by a native-English professional reader.
Structural equivalence does not guarantee semantic equivalence: two versions can align structurally while individual wordings differ in the strength of their claim, a layer not tested here.

records.title_zh: 记录三 · HTML 无障碍走查
records.purpose_zh: 验证展示页在不使用鼠标、不启用脚本、不依赖颜色三种条件下，是否仍能读到同一套判断。
records.purpose_en: To verify that the display page still delivers the same judgements without a mouse, without scripting, and without relying on colour.

execution.tool: playwright-core 1.58.2 无头 Chromium；Chrome DevTools Protocol Accessibility.getFullAXTree
execution.environment_zh: 本地 file:// 协议加载，全程离线，无远程请求

checks.item_zh: 键盘 Tab 焦点序列与出口
checks.item_en: Keyboard tab order and exit
checks.method_zh: 从页首起逐次按 Tab，记录每一步的焦点元素、可访问文本、aria-pressed 状态与 :focus-visible 匹配结果，直至焦点离开文档并循环回起点
checks.method_en: Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the page, recording the focused element, its accessible text, aria-pressed state, and :focus-visible match at each step, until focus leaves the document and returns to the start
checks.tool: playwright 键盘注入 + DOM 状态读取
checks.scope_en: Both language versions, whole page
checks.result_zh: 双语各 32 个可聚焦元素，序列完全一致：第 1 步跳转链接；第 2—16 步十五个章节导航链接；第 17—18 步两个指向第 16 章的正文链接；第 19—20 步 AI 开启与 AI 关闭；第 21 步播放引导流光；第 22 步显示静态视图；第 23—32 步 OP-01 至 OP-10 十个节点按钮。第 33 步焦点离开文档进入浏览器界面，第 34 步循环回跳转链接，未发现键盘陷阱。Shift+Tab 反向遍历顺序可逆，实测 OP-05 反向依次回到 OP-04、OP-03、OP-02、OP-01。
checks.result_en: 32 focusable elements in each language, in an identical order: step 1 the skip link; steps 2-16 the fifteen chapter navigation links; steps 17-18 two in-text links to chapter 16; steps 19-20 AI ON and AI OFF; step 21 play guidance flow; step 22 show static view; steps 23-32 the ten node buttons OP-01 to OP-10. At step 33 focus leaves the document into the browser interface and at step 34 it returns to the skip link; no keyboard trap was found. Shift+Tab reverses the order correctly, measured from OP-05 back through OP-04, OP-03, OP-02, OP-01.
focus_sequence: 01 a.skip → 跳到正文 / Skip to content
02-16 nav a → 章节 02 至 16 导航链接（15 个）
17 a → 前往第 16 章「交互场景」/ Go to chapter 16
18 a → 第 16 章「交互场景」/ Chapter 16, Interactive scene
19 button[data-jz=on] → AI 开启 / AI ON（aria-pressed=true）
20 button[data-jz=off] → AI 关闭 / AI OFF（aria-pressed=false）
21 button[data-jz=play] → 播放引导流光 / Play guidance flow
22 button[data-jz=static] → 显示静态视图 / Show static view
23-32 button[data-node=OP-01..OP-10] → 十个独立完成节点
33 焦点离开文档（浏览器界面）
checks.limitations_zh: 以 Chromium 的焦点行为为准；其他浏览器引擎的 Tab 顺序与 :focus-visible 判定可能不同，本次未在其他引擎上复测

checks.item_zh: 焦点可见性
checks.item_en: Focus visibility
checks.method_zh: 在每一步 Tab 后读取焦点元素的 :focus-visible 匹配结果与 outline 的计算样式
checks.method_en: After each Tab step, read the focused element's :focus-visible match and computed outline style
checks.tool: playwright + getComputedStyle
checks.scope_zh: 双语展示页全部 32 个可聚焦元素
checks.scope_en: All 32 focusable elements in both language versions
checks.result_zh: 32 个元素全部匹配 :focus-visible 且有可见焦点样式。交互场景内 14 个按钮为 3 像素实线珊瑚色描边（rgb(215,100,80)，偏移 2 像素），页面其余 18 个链接为浏览器默认 1 像素蓝色描边（rgb(0,95,204)，偏移 1 像素），无元素被 outline:none 抹除。
checks.result_en: All 32 elements match :focus-visible and show a visible focus style. The 14 buttons in the interactive scene use a 3 px solid coral outline (rgb(215,100,80), 2 px offset); the remaining 18 links use the browser default 1 px blue outline (rgb(0,95,204), 1 px offset). No element has its outline suppressed.
checks.limitations_zh: 页面自身只为交互场景定义了焦点样式，其余元素依赖浏览器默认样式；若浏览器默认样式与页面配色对比不足，焦点可见性会随浏览器而变，本次只在 Chromium 默认样式下量测

checks.item_zh: 跳转链接实操
checks.item_en: Skip-link operation
checks.method_zh: 冷启动后按一次 Tab，量测跳转链接是否进入视口、是否具备可读底色，再按 Enter 并量测跳转结果与后续 Tab 的落点
checks.method_en: Press Tab once after a cold load, measure whether the skip link enters the viewport with a readable background, then press Enter and measure the jump result and where the next Tab lands
checks.tool: playwright 键盘注入 + 视口坐标量测 + 截图
checks.scope_en: Both language versions
checks.result_zh: 第一次 Tab 即命中跳转链接，从屏幕外移入视口左上角（16, 16），白色底、层级 99，可见。按 Enter 后地址片段变为 #main，页面滚动至正文容器顶部；再按一次 Tab，焦点落在正文容器内的第一个链接，跳过了十五个章节导航链接，跳转生效。
checks.result_en: The first Tab hits the skip link, which moves from off-screen into the viewport at (16, 16) on a white background at z-index 99. Pressing Enter sets the fragment to #main and scrolls to the top of the main container; the next Tab lands on the first link inside main, skipping the fifteen chapter navigation links, so the jump works.
checks.limitations_zh: 正文容器未设 tabindex="-1"，焦点本身未落到容器上，而是依赖 Chromium 的顺序焦点导航起点机制把后续 Tab 起点移入正文。在不实现该机制的浏览器与屏幕阅读器组合下，激活跳转链接后焦点可能仍留在文档起点。此项本次只在 Chromium 上验证。

checks.item_zh: 交互场景控件的键盘可操作性
checks.item_en: Keyboard operability of the interactive-scene controls
checks.method_zh: 对每个控件先用键盘取得焦点，再按 Enter 或空格触发，量测触发后的 DOM 状态、aria-pressed、读数面板与状态播报区文本
checks.method_en: Focus each control by keyboard, trigger it with Enter or Space, and measure the resulting DOM state, aria-pressed value, readout panel, and status live-region text
checks.tool: playwright 键盘注入 + DOM 状态读取
checks.scope_zh: AI 开关两个按钮、播放引导流光、显示静态视图、十个节点按钮、场景卡关闭按钮，共 15 个按钮
checks.scope_en: The two AI switch buttons, play guidance flow, show static view, the ten node buttons, and the scenario-card close button: 15 buttons in total
checks.result_zh: 包内自称的「键盘可操作」经实测成立。AI 关闭按 Enter：场景状态切至 off，aria-pressed 互换，画布可访问描述改写为 AI 关闭态描述，状态播报区输出「已切换到 AI 关闭……读数与 AI 开启完全一致」；AI 开启按空格：状态切回 on。两态下读数面板六行完全一致（10 / 10、2、3 / 3、未测（unknown）、2、待现场审计 · CR-2026-08-12-003）。播放引导流光按 Enter 可开可关，aria-pressed 随之 true / false。显示静态视图按 Enter 后画布隐藏、静态后备图显示，再按一次返回交互视图。十个节点按钮逐个用 Enter 展开，10 / 10 全部成功，卡片内编号、名称、AI 开启通道、AI 关闭通道与人工接管四项均非空。按 Esc 关闭卡片后焦点归还原节点按钮，aria-pressed 复位为 false，播报区输出「已关闭场景卡」。卡片展开时关闭按钮进入 Tab 序列，位于显示静态视图与 OP-01 之间，可用键盘触达并激活，激活后焦点同样归还原节点按钮。
checks.result_en: The package's claim of keyboard operability holds under test. Enter on AI OFF switches the scene state to off, swaps aria-pressed, rewrites the canvas accessible description to the AI-off wording, and announces "Switched to AI OFF ... The readout is identical to AI ON" in the live region; Space on AI ON switches back. The six readout rows are identical in both states (10 / 10, 2, 3 / 3, unknown (unmeasured), 2, pending site audit CR-2026-08-12-003). Enter toggles the guidance flow on and off with aria-pressed following. Enter on show static view hides the canvas and shows the static fallback, and a second Enter returns to the interactive view. All ten node buttons open with Enter, 10 of 10 succeeding, with card id, name, AI-ON channel, AI-OFF channel, and human-handover all non-empty. Esc closes the card, returns focus to the originating node button, resets aria-pressed to false, and announces "Scenario card closed". While a card is open the close button joins the tab order between show static view and OP-01, is reachable and operable by keyboard, and also returns focus to the originating node button.
checks.limitations_zh: 以 Chromium 的键盘事件处理为准；未在屏幕阅读器的浏览模式与焦点模式切换下验证播报的实际朗读顺序

checks.item_zh: 减少动效偏好
checks.item_en: Reduced-motion preference
checks.method_zh: 以 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 载入页面，量测动效控件状态与提示文本
checks.method_en: Load the page under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and measure the motion control's state and hint text
checks.tool: playwright reducedMotion 上下文
checks.scope_en: The interactive scene in both language versions
checks.result_zh: 播放引导流光按钮自动置为 disabled 且 aria-pressed=false，页面显示提示「已按系统的『减少动效』设置停用动画」（英文版为对应表述），动效不自动播放
checks.result_en: The guidance-flow button is automatically disabled with aria-pressed=false and the page shows "Animation is disabled because the system asks for reduced motion" (with the matching Chinese wording in the zh version); no animation plays automatically
checks.limitations_zh: 只验证了系统偏好为 reduce 时的行为，未验证用户在页面运行中改变系统偏好的响应

checks.item_zh: 替代文本清点
checks.item_en: Alternative-text inventory
checks.method_zh: 枚举全部 img 与 svg 元素，逐个读取 alt、aria-label、role、aria-hidden 与所在位置，统计有无并抽样判读质量
checks.method_en: Enumerate every img and svg element, read alt, aria-label, role, aria-hidden, and location for each, tally presence, and sample-read quality
checks.tool: playwright DOM 枚举 + CDP 可访问性树
checks.scope_zh: 双语展示页全部图像元素
checks.scope_en: All image elements in both language versions
checks.result_zh: 每版 9 个 img，9 个全部具备非空 alt，无缺失、无空 alt。中文版 alt 长度 25—121 字符，英文版 178—403 字符（中英字符密度不同，信息量相当）。抽样判读：五张图版的 alt 均描述图面内容与结论要点而非仅给标题，例如慢行图 alt 写明按 EPSG:4548 真实比例绘制、AI 开启域与关闭域及两者差集、差集为待现场审计的靶区。每版 1 个内联 svg（品牌标识），设 role="img" 并配 aria-label 描述图形构成。装饰性元素共 12 个，其中交互场景图例的 6 个色块与 6 个开关标记设 aria-hidden="true"。
checks.result_en: 9 img elements per version, all 9 with non-empty alt; none missing, none empty. Chinese alt text runs 25-121 characters and English 178-403, carrying comparable information at different character densities. Sample reading: the alt on all five drawings describes content and conclusions rather than only a title; the mobility drawing's alt states that it is drawn to true scale in EPSG:4548 and names the AI-on domain, the AI-off domain, and the difference set as a target for site audit. Each version has one inline svg (the brand mark) with role="img" and an aria-label describing its construction. Twelve decorative elements exist, of which the six legend swatches and six switch ticks in the interactive scene carry aria-hidden="true".
checks.limitations_zh: alt 质量为抽样人工判读，未逐条评估是否完整传达图面全部信息；alt 无法替代复杂图版的完整数据，图内数据的等价获取路径依赖正文与结构化文件

checks.item_zh: 无脚本降级路径实测
checks.item_en: No-script fallback verified by execution
checks.method_zh: 以禁用 JavaScript 的浏览器上下文实际加载页面，量测交互控件是否隐藏、noscript 降级文本与后备图是否呈现及其渲染尺寸，并截图留存
checks.method_en: Load the page in a browser context with JavaScript disabled, measure whether the interactive controls are hidden and whether the noscript text and fallback image render and at what size, and keep a screenshot
checks.tool: playwright javaScriptEnabled:false 上下文 + 元素截图
checks.scope_zh: 双语展示页第 16 章交互场景及全页图版
checks.scope_en: Chapter 16 interactive scene and all page drawings, both language versions
checks.result_zh: 禁用脚本后，交互控件条、舞台与节点导轨三块按 noscript 内的样式规则全部隐藏；noscript 降级文本呈现（中文「此处为交互场景。当前浏览器未启用脚本，下图为静态后备视图。」，英文为对应表述）；静态后备图实际渲染，中文版 1384 × 525 像素，英文版 1384 × 517 像素，且带非空 alt。图例与口径说明两块保持可见，读者仍可获得线型、形状与边界含义。全页六张章节图版与首屏后备图在无脚本条件下均正常呈现。
checks.result_en: With scripting disabled, the control bar, stage, and node rail are all hidden by the rules inside noscript; the noscript fallback text renders ("This is an interactive scene. Scripting is disabled in this browser, so the static fallback view is shown below.", with the matching Chinese wording); the static fallback image actually renders at 1384 x 525 px (zh) and 1384 x 517 px (en) with non-empty alt. The legend and the caveat note stay visible, so line types, shapes, and boundary meanings remain available. All six chapter drawings and the first-screen fallback image render normally without scripting.
checks.evidence_zh: 本次走查对无脚本状态下的交互场景区做了元素截图留存，用于人工复看
checks.limitations_zh: 禁用脚本的降级已验证；未验证脚本加载失败但未被禁用（如资源加载中断）时的中间态表现

checks.item_zh: 字幕、音轨与文字稿在 HTML 中的挂载
checks.item_en: Caption, audio, and transcript attachment in the HTML
checks.method_zh: 枚举页面内 video、audio 与 track 元素，并检索指向字幕、媒体与文字稿文件的链接
checks.method_en: Enumerate video, audio, and track elements in the page and search for links pointing to caption, media, or transcript files
checks.tool: playwright DOM 枚举
checks.scope_en: Both language versions, whole page
checks.result_zh: 实测结果为零：双语展示页均不含 video 或 audio 元素，track 元素数为 0，页面内也没有指向 .vtt、.mp4、.m4a 或文字稿的链接。因此本页不存在字幕轨挂载问题，也没有可在页面内核查的字幕开关。短片、语音导览、四个字幕文件与三份文字稿作为独立资产随包提交于 assets/media，其双语等价性由记录二第 07、08 条覆盖。
checks.result_en: The measured result is zero: neither language version contains a video or audio element, the track count is 0, and the page carries no link to .vtt, .mp4, .m4a, or a transcript. There is therefore no caption track to attach on this page and no in-page caption control to check. The film, the audio guide, the four caption files, and the three transcripts are submitted as separate assets under assets/media, and their bilingual equivalence is covered by entries 07 and 08 of Record 2.
checks.limitations_zh: 如实登记的结果是「页面内无时基媒体」。时基媒体的可及性因此不由本页承担，而依赖使用者自行以外部播放器载入随包字幕；页面未提供播放入口这一点属于设计现状，不属于本次修复范围

checks.item_zh: 颜色非唯一编码逐项核查
checks.item_en: Item-by-item check that colour is never the only encoding
checks.method_zh: 对每一处以颜色区分信息的位置，读取其形状线索（边框样式、圆角、裁剪路径、渐变）与文字线索，逐项判断是否存在第二编码
checks.method_en: For every place where colour distinguishes information, read its shape cues (border style, radius, clip path, gradient) and text cues, and judge item by item whether a second encoding exists
checks.tool: playwright getComputedStyle 逐元素读取
checks.scope_zh: 交互场景图例六项、品牌色板六项、十节点卡片、读数面板、七类测试与三类自检状态卡
checks.scope_en: The six legend entries in the interactive scene, the six brand swatches, the ten node cards, the readout panel, the seven test cards, and the three self-check status cards

findings.encoding_zh: 实线色条 + 文字标签「主脊 · 通用可达底线」+ 说明「两条等价路径之一」
重复线性渐变呈虚线形态（非实色）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「虚线，第二条等价路径」
圆形（border-radius 50%）+ 文字标签含编号区间 OP-01—OP-10
菱形（clip-path 四点多边形）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「珊瑚色只用于人工接管与求助」
三角形（clip-path 三点多边形）+ 文字标签 + 三处地标名称

findings.item_zh: 图例·临时重点区与总体范围
findings.encoding_zh: 虚线边框（border-style dashed）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「虚线边表示非法定边界」
每张卡片文本内含十六进制色值与色名（如「深青 #10383d」），并附用途说明；色块本身为纯装饰
卡片顶边颜色按位置轮换，仅作版面节奏，不承载信息；每张卡片以文字给出节点编号、场景编号、闸门编号与名称
术语与数值均为文字（含「未测（unknown）」「待现场审计」），不以颜色区分声明值与实测值，两者以文字术语分列
每张卡片以文字标注「待真实测试」，不以颜色表示状态
以文字给出状态（PASS AFTER FINALIZE、PASS · PROVISIONAL WARNINGS、PASS AFTER FINAL QA），不以颜色表示通过与否
第 12 章明写「颜色不得单独承载信息：任何以颜色区分的状态必须同时具备形状、文字或触觉冗余」，英文版有对应表述

checks.result_zh: 逐项核查 12 项，未发现以颜色为唯一编码的信息。所有颜色区分处均同时具备形状、线型或文字标签中的至少一种第二编码，与页面自述规则一致。
checks.result_en: Twelve items checked one by one, with no information found to be encoded by colour alone. Every colour-coded distinction also carries at least one of shape, line type, or a text label, consistent with the rule the page states about itself.
checks.limitations_zh: 以计算样式与文本内容判断，未做色觉障碍模拟渲染，也未请色觉障碍使用者判读

checks.item_zh: 页面结构与地标
checks.item_en: Page structure and landmarks
checks.method_zh: 统计标题层级、地标元素、状态播报区与控件可访问名，并用 CDP 读取完整可访问性树核对地标名称
checks.method_en: Count heading levels, landmark elements, live regions, and control accessible names, and read the full accessibility tree via CDP to verify landmark names
checks.tool: playwright DOM 统计 + CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree
checks.scope_en: Both language versions, whole page
checks.result_zh: 双语计数全等：h1 各 1 个、h2 各 16 个、h3 各 3 个，层级无跳级；地标 nav 1、main 1、footer 1，首屏概览段落设 aria-label；状态播报区 1 个，role="status" 且 aria-live="polite"，以视觉隐藏但屏幕阅读器可读的方式实现；按钮 15 个，其中 14 个带 aria-pressed 状态；AI 开关外层设 role="group" 并有可访问名；画布设 role="img" 并随 AI 开关改写 aria-label。跳转链接目标存在。全部 9 个图像均带 alt，aria-label 各 5 处，双语数量一致。
checks.result_en: Counts are identical in both languages: 1 h1, 16 h2, 3 h3, with no skipped levels; landmarks are 1 nav, 1 main, 1 footer, with the first-screen overview section carrying an aria-label; one live region with role="status" and aria-live="polite", implemented as visually hidden but screen-reader readable; 15 buttons, 14 of them carrying aria-pressed; the AI switch wrapper has role="group" with an accessible name; the canvas has role="img" with an aria-label rewritten as the AI switch changes. The skip-link target exists. All 9 images carry alt, and there are 5 aria-labels per version, equal across languages.
checks.limitations_zh: 结构与名称的机器核对，未验证屏幕阅读器实际朗读时的地标跳转体验

record_limitations_zh: 本走查为机器辅助走查：以无头浏览器注入键盘事件、读取计算样式与可访问性树的方式进行，未经屏幕阅读器与辅助技术使用者实测。
未使用 NVDA、JAWS、VoiceOver、TalkBack 等屏幕阅读器验证实际朗读顺序与措辞，也未做放大镜、语音控制、开关控制或单手操作的验证。
只在 Chromium 引擎与 1440 × 900 视口下量测，未在其他浏览器引擎、移动端触屏或高对比度模式下复测。
本记录是方案方自查，不是无障碍合规认证，不构成对任何标准符合性等级的声明。
record_limitations_en: This is a machine-assisted walkthrough: keyboard events were injected through a headless browser and computed styles and the accessibility tree were read. It was not tested with screen readers or by assistive-technology users.
No screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) was used to verify actual reading order or phrasing, and no magnifier, voice control, switch control, or one-handed operation was tested.
Measurements were taken only on the Chromium engine at a 1440 x 900 viewport, without retesting on other browser engines, mobile touch screens, or high-contrast mode.
This record is the proposer's self-check, not an accessibility conformance certification, and asserts no level of conformance with any standard.

findings.status_en: Found in the walkthrough and fixed
findings.problem_zh: 中文页面（lang="zh-CN"）的章节导航地标可访问名为英文小写 chapters，与页面语言不符，也与同页其余四处中文 aria-label 的体例不一致。经 CDP 可访问性树核对，该地标在树中的名称确为 chapters。
findings.problem_en: On the Chinese page (lang="zh-CN") the chapter-navigation landmark had the accessible name "chapters" in lowercase English, which does not match the page language and is inconsistent with the four other Chinese aria-labels on the same page. The CDP accessibility tree confirmed the landmark name as "chapters".
findings.fix_zh: 中文版改为「章节导航」，英文版同步改为 Chapters（与同页其余可访问名的首字母大写体例一致）。
findings.fix_en: Changed to 章节导航 in the Chinese version and to Chapters in the English version, matching the capitalisation of the other accessible names on the page.
findings.verification_zh: 修复后重跑 CDP 可访问性树，中文版地标名为「章节导航」，英文版为 Chapters；双语计数断言全等：aria-label 各 5、nav 各 1、导航链接各 15、按钮各 15、图像各 9 且 9 个均有 alt、可聚焦元素各 33（含展开态的场景卡关闭按钮），页面脚本错误 0。

findings.status_zh: 走查发现，登记为已知问题，本轮未修
findings.status_en: Found in the walkthrough, registered as a known issue, not fixed this round
findings.problem_zh: 节点选中时的状态播报文本由「前缀 + 节点编号 + 节点名称 + 句号」拼接而成，句号在代码中硬编码为中文全角句号，中英两版共用同一行拼接代码。实测英文版播报为「Selected OP-04 Continuous-passage break joint-test point。」，英文语句末尾出现中文全角句号。
findings.problem_en: The status announcement for a selected node is assembled as prefix + node id + node name + full stop, and the full stop is hard-coded as a Chinese ideographic period in a line shared by both languages. The English announcement was measured as "Selected OP-04 Continuous-passage break joint-test point。", ending an English sentence with a Chinese period.
findings.impact_zh: 屏幕阅读器在英文语音引擎下遇到全角句号，可能不作断句处理或读出异常字符；同时这是英文版文本中混入中文标点，与包内双语等价纪律不一致。
findings.suggested_fix_zh: 把句号并入语言字典，中文用「。」英文用「.」，拼接处不再硬编码标点。
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: 该文件不在本轮写入范围内（本轮仅允许写入本记录文件、proposal 双语挂接句与 visual/index.html、visual/index.en.html）。如实登记，不隐瞒，交由后续轮次处理。

findings.status_zh: 双语抽检发现，登记为已知问题，本轮未修
findings.status_en: Found in bilingual sampling, registered as a known issue, not fixed this round
findings.location: proposal.md 第 622 行与第 623 行之间
findings.problem_zh: 中文版正文在「上表三类人群不新增用户画像……」段与「**伦理与同意协议包（模板 · 未执行）。**」段之间缺一个空行，两段在 Markdown 语义下被视为同一段落；英文版对应位置有空行，分为两段。逐行结构类型比对因此从该处起出现一行偏移，折叠空行后结构类型序列仍为零不一致，说明差异仅在段落分隔而非结构本身。
findings.problem_en: In the Chinese text there is no blank line between the paragraph beginning "上表三类人群不新增用户画像" and the paragraph beginning "**伦理与同意协议包（模板 · 未执行）。**", so Markdown treats them as one paragraph, while the English version has the blank line and renders two. The line-by-line comparison therefore shifts by one line from that point; with blank lines collapsed the type sequence still shows zero mismatches, confirming the difference lies in paragraph separation rather than structure.
findings.impact_zh: 已传导到渲染产物：report/proposal.html 中该加粗小标题与上一段合并在同一个 p 元素内，而 report/proposal.en.html 正确另起一段。这使中文读者失去一个段落级的内容分隔，屏幕阅读器按段落导航时也会把两段读作一段。
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: proposal.md 在本轮的写入范围仅限一句挂接句，段落分隔属于正文改动，不在授权范围内。如实登记，交由后续轮次处理。

findings.status_zh: 走查观察，实测通过，登记为跨浏览器稳健性局限
findings.status_en: Observation; passed under test, registered as a cross-browser robustness limitation
findings.problem_zh: 正文容器未设 tabindex="-1"，跳转链接激活后焦点并未落到容器本身，而依赖 Chromium 的顺序焦点导航起点机制把后续 Tab 起点移入正文。
findings.measurement_zh: 在 Chromium 上实测：激活跳转链接后地址片段变为 #main、页面滚到正文顶部，随后一次 Tab 落在正文内第一个链接，跳过十五个导航链接，功能上生效。
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: 本轮实测该路径在目标环境下有效，且加设 tabindex="-1" 会使正文容器在键盘激活时匹配 :focus-visible，产生一圈环绕整页正文的焦点描边（已用副本实测确认），需另配样式抑制，改动面超出「仅走查修复」的范围。如实登记为已知局限，建议后续连同焦点样式一并处理。

findings.status_zh: 走查观察，经可访问性树实测确认无播报影响，未修改
findings.status_en: Observation; the accessibility tree confirms no announcement impact, left unchanged
findings.location: visual/index.html · visual/index.en.html · 第 12 章品牌色板的六个色块元素
findings.problem_zh: 品牌色板的六个装饰色块未设 aria-hidden="true"，而交互场景图例的六个色块设了，同页同类装饰元素的处理体例不一致。
findings.measurement_zh: 用 CDP 读取完整可访问性树核对：品牌色板的六个色块在树中的节点数为 0，交互场景图例已设 aria-hidden 的六个色块同样为 0。两组表现完全相同，说明这六个空元素本就不进入可访问性树、不产生任何播报。
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: 实测证明加设 aria-hidden 对播报结果无任何差别，属于体例统一而非缺陷修复。按最小改动原则不作修改，如实登记为观察项。

findings.problem_zh: 双语展示页均不含 video 与 audio 元素，track 元素数为 0，页面内也无指向字幕、媒体或文字稿的链接。短片、语音导览、四个字幕文件与三份文字稿以独立资产随包提交。
findings.note_zh: 本项不是缺陷判定，而是走查范围内的事实登记：页面不承担时基媒体的播放，因此不存在可在页面内核查的字幕挂载与字幕开关。

findings.status_zh: 走查观察，无害冗余，未修改
findings.problem_zh: 焦点样式规则同时覆盖交互场景内的按钮与画布，但画布未设 tabindex，实测不可聚焦，该规则中的画布选择器不会生效。
findings.note_zh: 键盘路径由十个节点按钮承担，页面亦以文字写明「用鼠标点击场景中的节点，或用 Tab 走到下方节点按钮后按 Enter」，键盘等价路径完整，故该冗余不构成缺陷。

findings.status_zh: 历轮抽检查获并已修复
findings.status_en: Caught and fixed in an earlier round
findings.problem_zh: 逐页结构块比对与溢出检测曾查获英文版一处 19.6 毫米的内容溢出，已修复；当前溢出检测结果为 0。
findings.note_zh: 此条如实登记，用以说明该项比对确实具备查错能力，而非只产出通过结论。
